Moral Philosophy

Indeed, our study of philosophy has developed to the point where there are three major groups of study. One propose we as a nation should propser only when the lowest of all is prospering. For the greater good they call it. Another propose survivalism and natural selection. Only the strong will succumb the weak. While another rejects both of these proposals and propose that we let things take their own course. What do you suppose we support?
We should all live and help each other for the greater good!
[ICON_BULLET][COLOR_RESEARCH_STORED]+5 [ICON_FLOWER] Morality[ENDCOLOR]
The government support the cause of the greater good!
Let things take their own course without intervention.
[ICON_BULLET][COLOR_GREY]Nothing happens.[ENDCOLOR]
The government support the cause of non-intervention!
And we are strong are we not? We are not weak!
[ICON_BULLET][COLOR_WARNING_TEXT]-5 [ICON_OCCUPIED] Morality[ENDCOLOR]
The government support the cause of natural selection!
Civil Reforms

With political services and reform coming onto our new government, we must decide what to welcome and reject. Your foreign advisor suggest we adopt policies that involves the welfare of the people. Your economic advisor suggest that we should be more open toward trade offers allowing more mercenaries and foreign markets to flow into our economy. Your military advisor however recommends we reform our justice and military system to uphold our might across the nation and the world. What do you insist we do?
Listen to the foreign advisor.
